01 — The Idea

What the name means.

Enlighten + fight. That's the name. The fight isn't something you get through before you grow. The fight is how you grow.

Learn

Every fight teaches

Every loss, every hard round, every bad day is information. Pay attention and it shows you who you are.

Grow

The opponent is you

The real fight is with the part of you that wants to quit, coast, or stay small. You beat him one day at a time.

Become

Keep showing up

There's no finish line. You show up again tomorrow.

Michael · Austin, TX
02 — My Story

62 years old.
Still in the fight.

I'm Michael. I started training over 40 years ago, and I never stopped.

Karate · Yoga · Jiu-Jitsu · Muay Thai · MMA

I've lost more rounds than I can count. Every one taught me something about fear, about ego, and about letting go.

People still training late in life inspired me. They made it possible for me. Now I want to make it possible for you.

That's ENFIGHTEN. Not a gym. Not a guru. A way to meet whatever you're fighting.

03 — Work With Me

Fight your own fight.

This isn't physical training. It's 1-on-1 mentoring: helping you fight your own fight, get stronger where it counts, understand yourself, and become more of who you are.

  • A guide, not a guru. 40+ years of showing up, losing, and learning, brought off the mat and into your life.
  • Your fight. Not a program to follow. Mindset, discipline, direction, the thing you keep avoiding. We go at it.
  • Direct. Just you and me, on whatever you're working on.
